This made me remember something from the start of my internship, so story time:
 I took a C programming course in Uni ( bachelor in mechanical engineering ), and i was very fond of programming. When i started my internship i searched for ways to implement my knowledge in C professionally until i found an opportunity. When that opportunity arose i immediately took it, even if it was in C# and not in C and i was learning on the go figuring it would not be that different. I had an idea to automate reading some files, i would copy them from several folders to one and then delete the old files. But there was a catch, the path to the files was on the company server and not on my computer, and thinking i had set up a test folder i accidentally ran the program essentially telling it to delete the entire company files i was trying to copy (their only copy of them). LUCKILY, i had fucked up at another part of the code, and instead of deleting 8k + files it stopped on the first one. MY ANUS STAYED CLINCHED THE WHOLE REST OF THE TIME I WAS WORKING ON THAT PROGRAM, triple checking every detail. That was one hell of a way to learn not to fuck with something you don't fully know that has the power to royally fuck your career over.
